Lea (Customer Success): FYI escalated from ACME. Rerank endpoint returns 413 when query + docs large, message unhelpful.
Sam (Backend): Can you paste exact error body?
Lea (Customer Success): Body was '413 Payload Too Large' and response body: 'request entity too large' — no field hint or token counts. Customer sent a ~2.1k char query + ~120 docs (avg ~2k chars each).
Alex (Eng-ML): Oof. Do we have per-request token accounting? Is this total tokens or per-doc? Could be hitting model/context limit or upstream proxy limit.
Lea (Customer Success): Customer says they were trimming individually but hit when they added a long free-text query. They want to know which field to trim.
Sam (Backend): Repro steps please.
Lea (Customer Success): cURL dump they used:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"<very long query text...>","documents":[{"id":"1","text":"<very long doc>"}, {"id":"2","text":"<very long doc>"}, ...]}'
```
Sam (Backend): Thanks. I reproduced locally. The 413 is thrown before our app-level validation — nginx/proxy fails on body size and returns a generic 413 with no body. That explains lack of token info.
Alex (Eng-ML): Makes sense. If proxy kills the request we won't know model limits. Two separate limits to consider: proxy max body bytes and model context token limits once accepted.
Mia (Docs): If it's proxy-level we should change error flow to return a friendly, actionable message: e.g. 'Request body exceeds the 8MB limit. Reduce number/size of documents or send fewer documents per request. See link'.
Lea (Customer Success): Customer needs actionable guidance. They asked specifically: "Which field should we trim first?" Also concerned about billing — will they be billed for this failed attempt?
Sam (Backend): We only bill on successful completions. 413 aborts early so no billing event is generated. I'll double-check billing pipeline but that is our current behavior.
Alex (Eng-ML): Short-term mitigations: 1) bump nginx max_body_size for `/v1/rerank` to something higher (careful with memory). 2) Add an early API-layer validator that returns a structured 413 with estimated token count and best-practice suggestions.
Sam (Backend): I'll open an infra ticket to increase max_body_size on the rerank route in staging and add logging to capture raw request size.
Lea (Customer Success): Please also give me a KB snippet I can send the customer: exact steps they can take to make the request succeed.
Mia (Docs): Draft KB checklist I can send: 1) Reduce number of documents (start with top 50 by relevance), 2) Truncate document text to top N chars or pass summarized snippets, 3) Move long user query into a shorter search/embedding step and send a concise rerank query, 4) Use streaming or chunked uploads if you need to send large corpora in batches. Include curl snippet showing how to send a reduced doc set.
Sam (Backend): Quick workaround we recommend to customers: sort by relevance, then call rerank on the top-K slice (e.g., 50 or 100). We can provide example code in Python.
Lea (Customer Success): I'll send that workaround now. Also please confirm whether we should recommend they chunk docs client-side or if we can provide an automatic chunker.
Alex (Eng-ML): For long-term, we should: - expose an estimated token calculator in SDKs, - return token-aware error with suggested max_docs and per-doc char limits, - consider server-side auto-snippeting for rerank when docs are huge.
Mia (Docs): Proposed user-facing error text (short): 'Request too large. Reduce number or size of documents. Try sending only top N documents or summarize long documents. See: https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank/oversize'.
Deploy Bot: Ticket INC-4821 created by Sam (Backend) — "Increase nginx max_body_size for /v1/rerank in staging; add size logging".
Sam (Backend): I'll follow up when infra patch is in staging.
Lea (Customer Success): Assigning product follow-up to Alex for the structured error and SDK calculator.
Alex (Eng-ML): Assigned — I'll prototype a validator that returns a response like: {"error":"request_too_large","limit_bytes":"8MB","suggested_top_k":"50","hint":"truncate document text or use snippets"}.
Lea (Customer Success): Thanks. I'll update the customer with the workaround and the KB link once Mia posts it.
Mia (Docs): KB draft uploaded: https://redwood.kb/internal/rerank-oversize-guide — feedback welcome.
Lea (Customer Success): Great, sending to customer now. :thumbsup: 
Sam (Backend): One action item for CS: ask customer to try with top-50 slice and confirm reproducible. If still 413, forward request-id and I'll pull logs.
Lea (Customer Success): Will do.
Mia (Docs): I'll include an example snippet for client-side truncation and a Python helper to compute rough tokens from chars.
Lea (Customer Success): Resolving on our side once KB sent. Will reopen if customer repros after workaround.
